speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) aims to bring out the best in every child and develop every Singaporean to their fullest potential.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We seek to nurture upright, resilient and confident Singaporeans, with the drive for lifelong learning and skills mastery and the strong desire to contribute to society.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will seek to enhance our students’ learning and educational experience, regardless of their abilities and starting points.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will continue to strengthen our focus on Character and Citizenship Education and enhance Values-in-Action programmes to provide students with more opportunities to build their character.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will deepen students’ understanding of our nation and society, as well as the region and the world.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will continue to build upon our bilingual language foundation and make the learning of languages encouraging and fun.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We are rolling out plans for enhanced outdoor learning and activities.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will foster the joy of learning in our students, to make learning meaningful and enduring for our students and foster a passion for lifelong learning.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will continue to enhance Applied and Experiential Learning in our schools and Institutes of Higher Learning (IHLs).

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: Through learning by doing, students will be able to cultivate an innovative spirit and apply their knowledge and skills in the real world.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will support students in uncovering their strengths and developing their talents, by ensuring that multiple pathways are available across the education system.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: This includes partnering industries to offer our students real world learning opportunities through programmes, such as the Institute of Technical Education’s (ITE's) Work-Learn Technical Diploma, the SkillsFuture Earn and Learn Programmes, and the SkillsFuture Work-Study Degree programmes.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: Through initiatives, such as Direct School Admission in schools and aptitude-based admission in IHLs, we recognise the interests and non-academic abilities of students in our admission systems.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will also formalise and strengthen Education and Career Guidance efforts to give students more time, guidance and opportunities to explore their interests, and decide on their specialisations and career options.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: To support this, we will streamline polytechnic courses and introduce more Common Entry Programmes.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We are bringing about a major change in our IHLs to also assume the mission of supporting the education and training needs of working adults.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: In support of industry transformation, our IHLs will significantly expand their offerings of industry-relevant and modular training programmes.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: Together with private training providers and employers, we will build a vibrant and high-quality lifelong learning industry that enables continual upskilling and reskilling of the workforce.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: All these efforts are anchored on the philosophy of SkillsFuture, which is to support all Singaporeans, regardless of their starting points, to uncover their strengths and interests, and learn throughout life through multiple pathways to develop skills mastery.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: Over time, our society will embrace a broad meritocracy of skills.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: Students will be empowered to learn anytime, anywhere and at their own pace.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will raise the capabilities of teachers as designers of learning experiences, leverage technology to improve learning experiences, and promote collaboration and cross-pollination of ideas.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will strengthen the interface between schools and parents through the Parents Gateway.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: This online platform will allow both groups to work together to better support the learning needs of our students.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: As we make bold strides in our education landscape, we must ensure that the disadvantaged are not left behind.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: Education will continue to be a key pillar of social mobility.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We are expanding the number of MOE Kindergartens, as part of the Government’s efforts to improve quality, affordability and accessibility in the preschool sector to ensure a good start for all children.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: Our schools will continue to provide equal opportunities for all students, regardless of background, to access quality education.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will continue to expand and strengthen our ecosystem of partnerships, working closely with our stakeholders to bring out the best in our students.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: This includes collaboration with Self-Help Groups to provide holistic support to less advantaged students and their families.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: To cater to students who need a conducive after-school care environment, we will expand the number of school-based Student Care Centres (SCCs) and places.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: They will cater to the educational, social and emotional well-being of our students, especially those from disadvantaged families.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We must uphold and enhance education as a platform for social mixing.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: The scope of MOE’s work has expanded over the years to also cover preschool and lifelong learning.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: It starts with the transmission of values, nurturing a curiosity to learn, and developing basic literacy and numeracy abilities.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: It continues through life with the acquisition of skills, knowledge and experience.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will continue to closely partner parents, employers and communities to mould the future of Singapore.
